tools.name: claudeseoskills__read_node
tools.description: Read one node's full markdown body + frontmatter by node_id. Response includes outbound_links[] (resolved graph edges) unless with_links:false, plus source attribution. Pass heading (e.g. "Tactics") to get ONLY that markdown section — a few hundred chars instead of the whole body; every heading read

tools.name: claudeseoskills__search_nodes
tools.description: Search nodes by text, node_type, and/or semantic `type`. Token-AND across title + description + tags. Primary retrieval path — use it before reading bodies. Results are ranked best match first — `score` on each row is the match strength (title hits count double). Page 1 is the top of the ranking. A

tools.name: claudeseoskills__list_ship_nodes
tools.description: List every node: node_id, title, parent_id, node_type, plus type/description/tags/resource when set. No bodies. This is a flat list of the WHOLE Ship — on a large one it is long and arrives in pages, so pass { cursor } to continue. To navigate rather than enumerate, use claudeseoskills__get_ship_dig

tools.name: claudeseoskills__get_ship_digest
tools.description: Orient on this Ship — ALWAYS call this first. With no arguments it returns the section MAP and nothing else: every top-level section with its description and child_count, which is small and cheap even on a Ship of hundreds of nodes. tools.name: claudeseoskills__get_blueprint_overview
tools.description: Read the human-AUTHORED overview prose for the Ship (omit node_id) or for one section. Useful only where someone has written a summary; it is not the way to navigate — claudeseoskills__get_ship_digest is the map, call that first.
